headline: Nahar Industrial Enterprises incorporates a wholly‑owned subsidiary
summary: Nahar Industrial Enterprises Ltd (NSE: NAHARINDUS) announced that it has incorporated a wholly‑owned subsidiary under the Companies Act. The subsidiary is intended to pursue specific business activities as part of the company's expansion strategy. The filing informs shareholders of a structural change that could affect future capital allocation and earnings. Retail investors should note the development as it may influence the company's growth trajectory and stock performance.
why_it_matters: Potential future earnings from new subsidiary

headline: Nahar Industrial Enterprises informs exchanges on share dematerialisation
hook: Routine depository update from Nahar Industrial
summary: Nahar Industrial Enterprises has submitted an update to the stock exchanges regarding the dematerialisation of shares. Dematerialisation converts physical share certificates into electronic form for trading on depositories. This is a standard procedural compliance for listed companies. Indian retail investors holding physical shares must dematerialise them to trade on the NSE or BSE.
why_it_matters: Standard procedural filing with no direct impact on stock price
